label: Admin
adds: Every table of the rulebook as an editable grid: rules, properties and their wiring, wording, layouts, the cast. Edits apply at once; Save writes the rulebook file.

label: Conformance
adds: Every engine's answers for the current facts, compared value by value with the conformance harness's own rule for when two values are equal.

label: Documentation in 16 languages
adds: Every rule of the model in plain language, generated from the rulebook.

label: Rulebook editor
adds: The generated editor for tables, fields and formulas, with its own database and API.

label: Interchangeable engines
adds: The same page, computed by Postgres views, generated TypeScript or the generated OWL and SHACL rules. Switch with the control above; nothing else changes.

label: Explainer
adds: Hover a dotted value for its rule in plain words and its witness: the values it came from, down to the stated facts.

label: The rulebook
adds: One JSON file holds the whole model. Everything on this page is built from it.

label: Excel, both ways
adds: Export the current rows as a workbook with every rule as a live formula, edit it, and import it again.
